## 2026-09-17 - [Prisma N+1 inside AI pipelines]
**Learning:** Sequential inserts (`tx.model.create`) inside loops for nested structures generated by AI (like quizzes with multiple questions) create severe N+1 bottlenecks.
**Action:** Always pre-process the AI response into a flattened data array, apply formatting (like `Prisma.InputJsonValue` for JSON), and use `createMany` inside a transaction for bulk insertion.
